title: Characterising and Analysing Retrieval-Augmented Generation Techniques
abstract: arXiv:2610.23226v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The advent of Large Language Models (LLMs) across many application domains has increased the need for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to reduce hallucinations and improve LLM performance. Thus far, several RAG techniques with impressive features and capabilities have been proposed in the literature, making it a herculean task to select the most appropriate RAG techniques for specific problem scenarios. Thus, we propose a conceptual framework comprising main dimensions and sub-dimensions for characterising (defining "what it is") and analysing (defining "how well it does") existing RAG techniques. The conceptual framework was developed through a qualitative analysis of the attributes of RAG techniques reported in the literature. It can serve as a pre-empirical filtering mechanism for researchers and practitioners in selecting the highest-fit RAG candidates that meet specific user and task requirements before empirical benchmarking of

translated_title: 检索增强生成技术的特征描述与分析
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在众多应用领域的兴起，增加了对检索增强生成（RAG）的需求，以减少幻觉并提升LLM的性能。迄今为止，文献中已提出多种具有出色特性和能力的RAG技术，这使得针对特定问题场景选择最合适的RAG技术成为一项艰巨的任务。因此，我们提出了一个由主要维度和子维度组成的概念框架，用于刻画（定义“它是什么”）和分析（定义“它表现如何”）现有的RAG技术。该概念框架是通过对文献中报道的RAG技术属性进行定性分析而开发的。它可以作为一种经验前筛选机制，帮助研究人员和从业者在进行实证基准测试之前，选择最符合特定用户和任务需求的高适配度RAG候选技术。
tldr: 提出了一个用于刻画和分析现有检索增强生成（RAG）技术的概念框架，可作为实证评估前的筛选机制，帮助研究者和实践者为特定问题场景选择最合适的RAG技术。
en_tdlr: Proposes a conceptual framework for characterizing and analysing existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques, serving as a pre-empirical filtering mechanism to help select the most suitable RAG techniques for specific problem scenarios.
